text:
Sam: Quick heads-up — proposing a staged "pinlift" tomorrow 10:00 PT to unpin runtime v3.2 and move canary pools to v3.3-rc1. Need SDK + model handshake before we touch quantized pools.
maya: what do you mean by handshake? specific tests/gates?
alex: I can cut an SDK shim release (1.4.2-canary) with the compatibility flag. will it be a hard dependency?
Sam: not hard. plan: SDK enables opt-in flag use_new_kv=true. runtime will advertise new kv behavior; SDK will fallback to old path if runtime doesn't respond. gate = smoke tests + perf/regression thresholds.
jordan: add embedding endpoint to smoke list pls — last time it spiked under 1k tokens.
rei: i'll run the eval harness against model variants (llama3q, llama3q-quant, gptx-lite) and post diffs. target is no >1% perf regression on safety/quality evals.
maya: list the perf gates? p95 latency? error rate? memory/oom?
Sam: gates: p95 latency <= baseline + 5ms, error rate <0.5% vs baseline, no new OOMs on longseq tests, KV cache hit behavior preserved for prefix caching tests.
alex: rollout plan?
Sam: staged rollout: stage0 (preflight) smoke on canary infra (manual) -> stage1 10% traffic 30m -> stage2 40% 1h -> stage3 100% 3h. if any gate fails during a stage we pause & rollback.
alex: i'll push 1.4.2-canary to npm + pypi tags and include migration notes. also will add quick feature toggle: REDWOOD_USE_NEW_KV.
maya: can deploy-bot schedule the job and make it visible in releases channel? want manual approval at stage0.
deploy-bot: @channel deploy scheduled by Sam for 2026-03-25T17:00:00Z. Commands: ``/deploy runtime v3.3-rc1 --env canary --staged`` ``/rollback runtime --to-pin pinlist_v51`` Approvals: manual at stage0 required.
jordan: rollback criteria? thresholds to auto rollback?
Sam: auto rollback triggers: error rate >1% absolute, p95 latency regress >20ms absolute, >2 OOMs on longseq per 30m. Manual rollback if eval diffs show quality drop >1.5% on generation tests.
rei: i'll run gen-regression-2026-03 set during stage0 and post results by 08:30 PT next day.
alex: tagging docs + release notes now. will include code snippet for backwards fallback: ``if !runtime.supports_kv_v2: use_legacy_kv()``
maya: can we keep quantized pool pinned until stage3? last time unpin of quant pool caused q8 kernels mismatch.
Sam: yes, quant pool remains pinned (pinlist_v51) for now. only float pools move.
jordan: I'll add Prometheus counters for embedding endpoint and a Grafana dashboard panel. Will also add alert: embedding_p95_regress > 15ms -> notify #eng-oncall.
maya: tagging @security — any compatibility/security concern with the shim?
alex: shim only toggles runtime path; doesn't change serialization. security reviewed by me and passes. will add a note in changelog.
Sam: preflight checklist (short): 1) SDK shim published, 2) eval diffs < thresholds, 3) smoke no OOM, 4) metrics dashboards wired, 5) manual approval logged. link: https://playbook.internal/runbooks/pinlift-2026 (internal).
rei: after stage1 i'll post aggregated diffs + sample generations.
maya: good. schedule looks tight but workable. force-schedule window?
Sam: keeping it in 2-hour change window to avoid overlap with infra maintenance. if anything lands earlier we'll reschedule.
deploy-bot: Note: when rollout begins, deploy-bot will post per-stage status and a summary webhook to #eng-releases. Use ``/deploy status <id>`` to fetch details.
alex: one more — I'll include a compatibility matrix in the release notes: runtime 3.3-rc1 <-> SDK 1.4.2-canary <-> model set (llama3q variants).
maya: ack. can someone own rollback when needed?
jordan: i'll own rollback procedures and run the rollback if thresholds hit.
Sam: thanks all. will open the formal change ticket and assign approvals. tagging follow-ups for tomorrow: @alex build, @rei evals, @jordan monitoring, @maya approvals. :thumbsup:
maya: :+1:
deploy-bot: Rollout plan saved as change-3147. Manual approval required at stage0.
